generation_members.surface_form: The two-step clustering approach provides interpretability by revealing different melting physics dominated by bonding types, with Cluster 1 governed by ionic bonding features and Cluster 2 by covalent bonding features.

Cluster 2 melting temperatures can be accurately represented with symbolic models depending on only two features: squared cohesive energy and inverse square root of periodic groups or electronegativities.
